text: 2.1 General requirements(1) Applicants must abide by the laws and regulations of China and the rules and regulations of the university, and respect Chinese social customs.(2) Applicants should be healthy, both physically and psychologically, with no criminal record, and meet the physical standards required for applying for a student visa or residence permit.2.2 Age and identification requirements(1) Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with valid passports.(2) Applicant should be at least 18 years old and not more than 35 years old (Scholarship applicants should meet all age requirements).2.3 Academic requirements(1) Equal to a bachelor's degree (or above) in China;(2) Full transcripts of final education, original or notarized version, in notarized Chinese or English Translation.2.4 Language proficiency(1) Applicants should obtain an HSK (Level 5) certificate after February 2023.(2) A scanned copy of score reports of the HSK tests. Admitted students are required to submit original copies of those official documents for verification. Those who provide fake materials will be disqualified from admission.2.5 Financial conditionApplicants should be able to pay tuition fees, accommodation and related daily living expenses.
